notes: OWNERSHIP: EVIDENCE: PAYLOAD_FIELD — every one of the 6 postings kept here carries `company.name` "Ubisoft" as a field of the provider's own payload, not as free text. MEASURED 2026-11-19, one plain GET (owner-approved), `GET https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/ubisoft2/postings?limit=100&offset=0` -> HTTP 200 application/json. THE IDENTIFIER IS CASE-INSENSITIVE ON THE WIRE AND CANONICALISED IN THE PAYLOAD: the request path carried the lower-case "ubisoft2" and the response answers `company.identifier` "Ubisoft2". That is the measurement `SMARTRECRUITERS_KIND` in ats-config.ts was waiting for, and it is why the lower-case-only slug alphabet is sound rather than merely cautious. The envelope is `{offset, limit, totalFound, content}`: offset 0, limit 100, totalFound 304, content 100 items — `totalFound` is the board's whole count, so the end of the list is `offset + content.length >= totalFound` and no cursor is sent. Each list item carries id (a numeric string), name, uuid, jobAdId, defaultJobAd, refNumber, company{identifier,name}, releasedDate (a UTC Z instant), location{city,region,country,remote,hybrid,fullLocation and sometimes latitude/longitude}, industry/department/function/typeOfEmployment/experienceLevel each as {id,label}, language, customField[], visibility ("PUBLIC") and, on SOME items, `creator` - the ONE object in the payload that NAMES A HUMAN (a recruiter). Every `creator` was DROPPED BY KEY from the committed file, here and in the detail capture, because these fixtures are public; nothing else was removed from an item. THE LIST CARRIES NO DESCRIPTION and no `postingUrl`: both live only in the per-posting detail, which is one further request each. `experienceLevel.label` IS in the list ("Mid-Senior Level"), so seniority needs no detail request. Kept 6 whole postings out of 100 on the page; the envelope's own fields are as received except `content`, whose length therefore describes the committed file rather than the live page. No GET was sent to any other host: jobs.smartrecruiters.com appears only as data inside the payload and was never requested. robots.txt of api.smartrecruiters.com (committed beside this file as api-robots.txt) disallows every agent except LinkedInBot; the documentation at https://developers.smartrecruiters.com/docs/endpoints calls the Posting API public and shows unauthenticated examples, states no terms of use and no rate limit, and the two conflict. The owner's 2026-10-24 ACCEPT_RISK decision knowingly accepts exactly that, "until banned"; nothing here was retried and no header was changed. No attribution obligation is stated in the documentation or the response. Every `creator` object (the only field naming a human) was dropped by key. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
